name: package-vetter
description: One-shot supply-chain vetter for an installed pi extension. Reads the package tree, applies workshop-001 rule taxonomy as a rubric (R-01..R-07), and emits a Verdict-shaped JSON report. Used by pij's pkg vet / pkg audit pipeline.
author: pij

files.description: Identity, run loop, rubric application protocol, Verdict emission. Frontmatter declares permissions: read-only filesystem, no network, no write.
Workshop-001 § Rule taxonomy verbatim — R-01..R-07 with intent, examples-that-fire, examples-that-don't, severity, FP-mitigation. The agent's hard rubric.
Per-file scan checklist, severity ladder application, context-aware downgrade rules (fenced code, defensive doc), aggregation.
JSON schema for input: packagePath (required), source (optional, for provenance in Verdict).
JSON schema for the Verdict envelope: { vetter, score, level, findings[], scannedFiles, durationMs, agentRubric }. Mirrors harness/scripts/vetters/types.ts Verdict shape verbatim.
